comment: Single source of truth for the xmedia-bridge line protocol. Consumed by TS (protocol.ts, imported directly) and by C++ (engine/src/xmedia_protocol.h, generated by product/xmedia/scripts/gen-protocol.mjs). Do NOT hand-edit the generated header — edit this file and re-run the generator. INDEX SEMANTICS: request/response arrays list PAYLOAD columns only, so index i means the (i+1)-th tab-separated field on the wire — field 0 is always the framing token ('<verb>' for hello/ping, 'ok' for ok-framed replies). bake.* verbs drive the offline HTML→MP4 pipeline (HyperFrames-aligned): the bridge spawns a one-shot xmedia-bake child per job; optionsJson carries the optional knobs (seconds/fps/width/height/codec/clock/dataJson/bakeBin) as a host-validated JSON object. publish.pause/resume drive the cooperative per-job pause of the TranscodeJob pool (takes effect at the next packet boundary; Cancel still wins while paused); publish.list returns the whole pool as one JSON array. statusJson gains trailing 'paused' and 'jobId' fields (additive, appended AFTER the fields pinned by the smoke offset test). protocolVersion stays 1: adding verbs is additive (see @mediabase/engine-client).
